scope: Lossless historical documentary recovery only. No source, test, workflow, dependency or migration changes are imported. Archived patches, scripts and workflow snapshots remain inert evidence. Original historical claims are not current qualification.

source_only_commits.subject: fix(export): complete manifest parity and qualify native reader
docs: preserve complete consolidation inventory and qualification evidence

payload_archive.format: USTAR in gzip level 9, sorted original paths; regular files only, mode 0644; mtime/uid/gid zero, empty owner/group names
payload_archive.byte_preservation: Every decompressed member was compared byte for byte with its original Git blob; SHA1 Git object preimage and SHA256 independently recomputed.
